known.title: Preserve npm lifecycle hooks when replacing a script's worker cap
Follow-up: Cap the launcher forms Forge already recommends
Preserve non-ASCII paths in the Node preload option

findings.body:
Gain 3, Work 1, Harm 3
Raise: Functional. `json.dumps` defaults to ASCII escaping, but [Node's NODE_OPTIONS parser](https://github.com/nodejs/node/blob/v22.x/src/node_options.cc#L1694) removes escape backslashes rather than decoding JSON Unicode escapes. If Forge is installed under a non-ASCII user directory such as `C:/Users/José/`, the preload path instead contains `Josu00e9`. Running `npm test` with a visible script such as `vitest run --maxWorkers=8` then fails with MODULE_NOT_FOUND before npm or its lifecycle hooks run. Preserve Unicode characters when constructing the quoted preload path.
findings.title: Preserve non-ASCII paths in the Node preload option
